tips.text: Start the Fieldron research the day you build the Energy Lab and gather materials while the 3-day timers run.
Do the research in a solo Ghost clan; bigger clan tiers multiply every cost.
Take Fieldron from Corpus Invasions, 3 per reward, instead of crafting it from samples.
Have a Forma ready; the recipe consumes one.
Expect the Fieldron Samples to be the only real pain; the rest is waiting on timers.
